deploy-bot: Starting deploy `release-1.9.0` to prod (tag=release-1.9.0, commit=abc1234). Running migration jobs: [2026_schema_v12, user_flags_backfill]. Canary -> 10% live. run_id=mr-7789. @carla @ben

carla: On it. Any ETA for the schema index build?

migration-runner: job `2026_schema_v12` started on db-primary-1 (pid=2245). Estimated ~12m, but depends on vacuum/replication.

ben: FYI if index build pushes CPU >80% or replication lag spikes, pause rollout.

migration-runner: user_flags_backfill started on workerset-3, batch_size=10000, total=1,200,000, progress=0/1,200,000

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% complete, no errors so far. Proceeding to 50% per rollout policy.

carla: seeing replica lag jump to ~300s on replica-2, I want to hold at 50%. pausing rollout now.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by request from @carla. Current exposure: 10% (canary). Notifying owners.

ben: can we avoid blocking by switching index creation to concurrent mode? If we cancel the aggressive index and start `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` on replicas, we can continue.

migration-runner: Received cancel request for job `2026_schema_v12` (run_id=mr-7789). Initiating cancellation sequence.

carla: please post the cancel command so ops can reproduce if needed.

ben: Command to cancel and start fallback:
```
/migration cancel mr-7789 2026_schema_v12
/migration start mr-7790 create_index_concurrent_v12 --target=replica-2,replica-3
```

migration-runner: job `2026_schema_v12` cancel acknowledged. Status -> CANCELING. No partial schema applied on primary.

migration-runner: job canceled. Starting fallback job `create_index_concurrent_v12` (run_id=mr-7790). Estimated 20-30m. Running on replica-2 then replica-3.

deploy-bot: Rollout remains paused. Will auto-resume when fallback completes and sanity checks pass.

carla: i'll watch the logs and replication. @ops-oncall-bot please alert if error rate >5% or replication lag >600s.

ops-oncall-bot: Alert rule registered: prod-repl-lag > 600s OR prod-error-rate > 5% -> paging oncall.

ben: thanks. once concurrent index is built and promoted we'll re-run canary to 50% then continue.

carla: noted. updating the release notes channel with a short blurb after we finish. :thumbsup:
